decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist of the album "Music of the Spheres." Multiple documents explicitly name different artists for albums with the same title. Document D1S1 identifies Ian Brown as the artist of *Music of the Spheres* (Ian Brown album). Document D5S1 identifies Mike Oldfield as the artist of *Music of the Spheres* (Mike Oldfield album). Document D3S1 identifies Taylor Swift as the artist of *Music of the Spheres* (Taylor Swift album). These are distinct referents for the same album title, so all three are valid answers.
